title: Leave Management
subtitle: Configure leave types and public holidays for your organisation
accessDeniedDescription: Leave management is only available to HR Admin and Executive roles.

leaveTypes.hintWithBusinessUnit: Active types appear in the leave request form for employees
leaveTypes.hintNoBusinessUnit: Select a business unit above to add or edit leave types
leaveTypes.empty: No leave types configured. Add one above.
leaveTypes.reactivateDescription: This leave type will become available again in the leave request form for employees.
leaveTypes.deactivateDescription: This leave type will be hidden from employees and cannot be selected for new requests. Existing approved leave and historical balances are preserved.
leaveTypes.errorHasPendingRequests: Cannot deactivate: there are pending leave requests for this type. Resolve them first.

dialog.approvalHint: Manager must approve requests for this type
dialog.errorDaysInvalid: Days must be 0 or more (0 = unlimited).

holidays.hintWithBusinessUnit: Holidays are excluded from business-day calculations on leave requests
holidays.hintNoBusinessUnit: Select a business unit above to add or edit holidays
holidays.empty: No holidays configured. Add one above.
holidays.deleteDescription: This holiday will be removed from the calendar. This action cannot be undone.

dialog.recurringHint: Repeat this holiday every year on the same date
